The '''Tauber system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Jaso sector/Legends|Jaso sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tauber]].
